required_before_execution.issue: Tool read caps do not bound Google Drive internal prefetch/network hydration
required_before_execution.tar_rule: Validate header checksum/member extents/end markers/nonzero trailing data; extension and sparse/link formats must be explicitly refused or identically constrained. Do not accept an empty archive as useful JSON readiness.
required_before_execution.correction: Guarantee only direct source-read/local-copy cap4MiB each and8MiB total; report provider completion and true transfer amounts unknown. Enforce byte/EOF/pre-post stat checks and exclusive new destination creation.

required_before_execution.issue: 10GiB environment budget excludes uncontrolled pip temp/cache unless scoped explicitly
required_before_execution.correction: Put wheel download, pip cache and scoped TEMP/TMP in own local run. Before installing compute downloaded wheel bytes plus ZIP unpacked package bytes plus staging reserve; verify total10GiB and free30GiB gates. Log post-install actual usage and stop new operations if reserve violated.
